changelog: NEW: POS keyboard shortcuts — Alt=checkout, Ctrl+C=calculator, Ctrl+Z=cycle sale mode, Ctrl+R=reverse last item
NEW: Auto-add product to cart on scan (no quantity prompt) — qty changeable in cart
NEW: Space in search allows multi-word queries (e.g. 'lemon biscuit')
NEW: After checkout, Space acts as Tab to move between fields
NEW: Shop Card auto-selects sale mode (Regular/Wholesale/Shopkeeper) based on card type
NEW: Shop Card info panel shows customer name, ID, advance/due balance, last transaction
NEW: Card payment — no amount prompt, Enter completes sale, discount only if advance balance
NEW: Main Store box purchase auto-recalculates sale prices when cost changes (maintains markup %)
FIXED: Settings check-update now queries GitHub Releases API for actual latest version
FIXED: Product page unchanged (as requested) — no modifications in this release
